findings.mechanism: Read‑modify‑write without SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE leads to lost updates under READ COMMITTED isolation (Reference: Correctness and cost at the database boundary).
findings.remediation: Use SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the wallet row or replace the read‑modify‑write with an atomic UPDATE statement that increments/decrements the balance in a single statement, then commit.
findings.arithmetic: Initial balance=100.00, N=10 concurrent debits of 10.00 each. Each transaction reads 100, subtracts 10 and writes 90; the last commit wins, so final_balance=90.00 (≥90.00) instead of 0.00.

prediction.condition: 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 on initial balance 100.00
